{{Quote|After them, before I turn you into a grub toad!|Morag threatens her beast|<ref name="e12" />}}
'''Grub toads''' were a creature that the [[Tulgah/Legends|Tulgah]] [[Witch/Legends|witch]] [[Morag]] threatened to turn her [[Morag's beast|beast]] into if it did not chase after the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]] and [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Warrick]]<ref name="e12" /> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="Date">{{InsiderCite|23|Star Wars Publications Timeline|''Star Wars'' Publications Timeline}} dates the events of the [[Star Wars: Ewoks (1985)|''Ewoks'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]], which include the events of [[Ewoks (1985) 12|''Ewoks'' 12]], to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which corresponds to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Grub [[Toad/Legends|toads]] were mentioned in the [[Ewoks (1985) 12|twelfth issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Ewoks (1985)|''Ewoks'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]], which was written by [[David Manak]]<ref name="e12" /> and published by [[Marvel Comics]] on [[December 2]], [[1986]].<ref name="marvelage">{{BookCite|title=[[Marvel Age]]|number=Vol. 1 No. 47|publisher=[[Marvel Comics]] Group|date=[[February]] [[1987]]|issn=8750-4367}}</ref>
